title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Hamburger Recipe MRL-063 Unlimited Common Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Unleash the power of strategic gameplay with the classic "Hamburger Recipe" card from the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG. This Spell-Ritual card, a staple from the iconic "- Yugi -" set, offers unlimited potential for players looking to bolster their deck. Manufactured in 1996, it's a vintage piece that brings a touch of nostalgia to any collection.

With its common rarity, this card is a timeless addition for both seasoned duelist and collectors alike. Enhance your game experience by incorporating "Hamburger Recipe" into your spellcasting arsenal and enjoy the simplicity of its straightforward gameplay. Add it to your collection and own a piece of Yu-Gi-Oh! history.
